sections.title: MULTI LANGUAGE INTERPRETATION (Chinese, Spanish, etc.)
sections.html:
Multi-language Interpretation services are only available in Boston Office and New York Office now. For other areas, only Chinese interpretation is provided.

AET has connections with experienced interpreters in most of major cities in America. With their specialized background and professionalism, they have delivered outstanding simultaneous and consecutive interpretation services on numerous occasions. We usually select interpreters in accordance with the clients' specific needs, so that their requirements could be best satisfied.

sections.title: HOW TO APPLY?
sections.html:
1. Find out which office provides service for your requested city. Contact Boston Office or New York Office for cities marked in blue(Boston, New York, Washington DC, Philadelphia, Baltimore, Seattle, Chicago, etc.)；Contact Miami Office for cities marked in black(Miami, San Francisco, Los Angeles, San Diego, Dallas, Austin, Houston, etc.).

2. Email the office and include: your contact info; requested service, time and place; how many interpreters and what experienced level are needed.

3. Application Process: File an application → Get a quote → Prepay → Arrange interpreters within the agreed-upon timeframe according to time, place, number and level of interpreter(s) required → If the arrangement is successful, translator information will be provided; if the arrangement is unsuccessful, a full refund will be given.
